title: docs(releases): drop the retired knowledge-ragflow from implementation-status
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKQhn8159SBVy85xb31ZjCh)_

Fixes #37481

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 是什么：文档改三处。实现状态页不再把已退役的 RAGFlow 适配器（`knowledge-ragflow`）列为随仓发布的插件。
- 为什么：这个包已由 PR #37477 删除，页面还写着它在，读者会以为能用。
- 出错会怎样：只改文档文字，没有代码和发布面；可直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

`content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx`, three lines, only the retired name is removed:

- line 311 (AI protocol table, **RAG Pipeline** row): `knowledge-memory` / `knowledge-ragflow` / `embedder-openai` plugins → `knowledge-memory` / `embedder-openai` plugins.
- line 329 (Notes under that table): the `knowledge-memory`, `knowledge-ragflow`, and `embedder-openai` plugins → the `knowledge-memory` and `embedder-openai` plugins.
- line 446 (Phase 10 checklist, RAG Pipeline item): the same edit.

This is a docs-only PR, as AGENTS.md's Documentation Guardrails ask for a factual error on a releases page (`content/docs/releases/` is never edited in a code PR). No published package changes, so it carries `skip-changeset`.

Premise, read on `main` 9609c137 before the edit: PR #37477 has merged (the card's `Blocked-by: #37004` is cleared) and no `knowledge-ragflow` package is left under `packages/plugins`.

## Why

The page told readers a retired adapter ships in this repo.

## Verification

- `git grep -n -i ragflow content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` returns nothing (exit 1), the card's Done-when.

<details><summary>runs</summary>

Head 2d895db9.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 52 commands. The docs and release-page families were run locally, all exit 0: `check-adr-links`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-doc-route-spelling --advisory`, `check-docs-section-name`, `check-issue-citations`, `check-release-section-coverage` (plain and `--strict`), `check-section-landing-index`, `check-comment-mask-corpus`, and `pnpm check:` `doc-anchors`, `doc-authoring`, `doc-frontmatter`, `docs-redirects`, `docs-single-h1`, `release-notes`, `release-page-status`, `issue-citations`, `docs-audit-scope`, `corpus-claim-drift`, `nul-bytes`, `role-word`, `closed-ceremony-text`, `docs-spec-enumerations`, `skill-identifier-liveness`, `vendor-version-stamps`, `published-readme-links`, `adr-anchors`.

NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI: `pnpm check:docs-transcript-drift` answered exit 3 (prerequisite: `@objectstack/lint` is not built in this container), and the remaining derived commands (spec, lint-package and `--self-test` checker-health families) were not run, since this diff touches none of their inputs.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The adapters that replaced RAGFlow, `knowledge-pgvector` and `knowledge-turso`, both live under `packages/plugins` but are not named on this page. Adding them is outside this card (its Done-when only removes the retired name), so the three lists now name `knowledge-memory` and `embedder-openai` only. A follow-up can add them if the page should list every store.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` was not run locally: the diff touches no lintable source.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (nothing publishes; `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [ ] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/releases/`. Deliberately not ticked: this is the dedicated docs-only PR that AGENTS.md prescribes for a factual error on a releases page.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 summary is the seat's Chinese summary for the maintainer)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

The branch is `claude/project-thread-yhu54n`, assigned by the platform rather than the repo's `claude/issue-<n>-…` convention.
